card.name: Words just before 'status' or emesis
card.fires_on: Fires on a word inside a phrase where the next word is likely a specific noun, such as 'induction of' before emesis, 'oxy-toc' before -in, or 'exit' before status. It is most common in overdose-treatment text and technical prose.

modes.label: Induction of emesis
modes.description: The word 'of' or part of 'emesis' in overdose treatment sentences about inducing vomiting.
modes.example: elimination of unabsorbed drug should be attempted by induction<< of>> emesis or gastric lavage.

modes.label: Inside oxytocin
modes.description: The middle piece of the drug name oxytocin, before the final '-in'.
